Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.02.2026 (6. фебруар ст. ст.) — „6. Свети мученици Марта и Марија и брат им Ликарион. Све троје распети на крст за Христа, па онда избодени и умртвљени копљем.“

attestations.note: Read from the Prologue text on the page, not from its entry list. She is in its sixth and shortest numbered entry for the day, which gives the three of them one sentence: all three crucified for Christ, and then pierced and killed with the spear. That agrees with the Russian life for the sisters and not for their brother, whom the Russian life has beheaded by the sword; the difference is recorded on his folder, in the row that prints it. The Prologue carries no year, no place and no commander, and its verses for the day add their old mother, who taught them to love Christ — the Russian life has her standing by at the execution.
